title: Ngā Reo i te taha o ngā Wai Mārie
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi hapori, ehara i te mea nō tētahi tāone, nō tētahi rangatira rānei, engari nō te wai marino i huihui ai te ora. He torutoru noa ngā whiti e maumahara ana ki tēnei hapori, e rārangi tonu ana i roto i te hunga i whakakahore i te arataki. Whakarongo mai ki a rātou e kōrero ana i te pōuri.
clues: He hapori tātou kua whakahuatia i roto i te Quran, heoi kei te huna tonutia tō tātou kōrero katoa i roto i te mea ngaro.
E whakahuatia tonutia ana mātou i te taha o te hunga i whakakahore, pērā i te iwi o Āta me te iwi o Thamud.
E kiia ana mātou ko ngā Hoa o Ar-Rass, te Puna i herea ai tō mātou oranga.
I whakakahoretia e mātou te karere i tonoa mai ki a mātou me te arataki mārama.
Kua taua tātou i roto i te hunga i whakakahore i ngā karere katoa i tonoa mai e Allah.
I tūtaki mātou ki te riri i tau ki runga i te hunga katoa e whakakahore ana i mua i a mātou, arā, te whakangaromanga mō tā mātou whakakahoretanga.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
